test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8th December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/577ede4c4612be7c76b08ea712971696b89494a9b526ba35041320509f2578e3.png]
solution:
The figure that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series is as shown below :

 
• The 2 is rotated 90⁰ clockwise and moves one step clockwise.
 
• The oval which is darken at one side is rotated 90⁰ anti-clockwise and moves one step anti-clockwise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/110129dee98e08a1b0dc4dc972054f60c5d64c452f2ccc42bb9b3bfa5774732d.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
